description: This file implements a lexer (tokenizer) for Smarty's internal configuration files, responsible for breaking down config file source code into tokens for parsing.

classes.name: Smarty_Internal_Configfilelexer
classes.description: Lexer class for parsing Smarty configuration files into tokens, managing internal states and patterns for token recognition.

methods.name: replace
methods.description: Replaces or processes input string; currently a placeholder that returns input as-is.

methods.name: PrintTrace
methods.description: Initializes trace output for debugging lexer states.

methods.name: yylex
methods.description: Dispatches lexing to state-specific methods based on current lexer state.

methods.name: yypushstate
methods.description: Pushes a new lexer state onto the stack and switches to it, with optional trace logging.

methods.name: yypopstate
methods.description: Pops the previous lexer state from the stack and returns to it, with optional trace logging.

methods.name: yybegin
methods.description: Sets the current lexer state directly, with optional trace logging.

methods.name: yylex1
methods.description: Lexing method for the 'START' state, recognizing tokens like comments, section headers, and identifiers.

methods.name: yy_r1_1
methods.description: Handles comment start token and enters COMMENT state.

methods.name: yy_r1_2
methods.description: Handles opening bracket token and enters SECTION state.

methods.name: yy_r1_3
methods.description: Handles closing bracket token.

methods.name: yy_r1_4
methods.description: Handles equal sign token and enters VALUE state.

methods.name: yy_r1_5
methods.description: Handles unrecognized tokens, continues lexing.

methods.name: yy_r1_6
methods.description: Handles newline token.

methods.name: yy_r1_7
methods.description: Handles identifier tokens.

methods.name: yy_r1_8
methods.description: Handles other miscellaneous tokens.

methods.name: yylex2
methods.description: Lexing method for the 'VALUE' state, recognizing data types, strings, booleans, and nested states.

methods.name: yy_r2_1
methods.description: Empty method, possibly indicating end of value tokens.

methods.name: yy_r2_2
methods.description: Handles float number token.

methods.name: yy_r2_3
methods.description: Handles integer number token.

methods.name: yy_r2_4
methods.description: Handles start of triple-quoted string, switches to TRIPPLE state.

methods.name: yy_r2_5
methods.description: Handles single-quoted string token.

methods.name: yy_r2_6
methods.description: Handles double-quoted string token.

methods.name: yy_r2_7
methods.description: Handles boolean or boolean-like tokens, with special processing based on config_booleanize setting.

methods.name: yy_r2_8
methods.description: Handles naked string tokens.

methods.name: yy_r2_9
methods.description: Handles empty naked string (possibly representing an empty value).

methods.name: yylex3
methods.description: Lexing method for the 'NAKED_STRING_VALUE' state, capturing raw text until a newline.

methods.name: yy_r3_1
methods.description: Handles completion of naked string token and returns to previous state.

methods.name: yylex4
methods.description: Lexing method for the 'COMMENT' state, recognizing comment text and newlines.

methods.name: yy_r4_1
methods.description: Indicates end of comment block, returning to START state.

methods.name: yy_r4_2
methods.description: Handles naked string within comments.

methods.name: yy_r4_3
methods.description: Handles newline within comment, returning to COMMENT state.

methods.name: yylex5
methods.description: Lexing method for the 'SECTION' state, recognizing section delimiters and subsections.

methods.name: yy_r5_1
methods.description: Handles dot token within sections.

methods.name: yy_r5_2
methods.description: Handles section end token and returns to previous state.

methods.name: yylex6
methods.description: Lexing method for the 'TRIPPLE' state, handling multi-line triple-quoted strings.

methods.name: yy_r6_1
methods.description: Detects ending of tripple-quoted string and returns to START state.

methods.name: yy_r6_2
methods.description: Reads the closing delimiter of a tripple-quoted string and processes it accordingly.
